decision: Reject the scalar paint cache. Retain one current application painter; add opt-in command-stream diagnostics only.
scope: No application/runtime, native executable, backend, geometry, source, job/evidence authority or dependency change is deployed. Rejected prototype remains solely an archived experiment.

tests.title: navigation details update references without duplicate background paint, while focus and surface reset remain visible

prototype.full_browser_suite: Interrupted after rejection; partial successes excluded from completed coverage. Detached test processes were explicitly cleaned up; production services protected.

stop.reason: Prototype rejected after controlled comparison; stop unused browser-suite startup. Required TUI completed successfully first.

cleanup.reason: Full rejected-prototype browser suite was interrupted. Detached Playwright children continued after the orchestrator group stopped; their exact environment-tagged process trees were cleaned up. Partial cases are not claimed as completed coverage.

comparison.methodology: Current/cache/cache/current, fresh Chrome 149 contexts per actual project, normal motion, 1440x960, no throttling. Same native executable and projects, static asset substitution retains native headers. No simultaneous build/test/inference/sampler during these eight captures. Document-thread browser spans; inclusive stages overlap. Two runs per strategy are diagnostic, not field percentiles. Native rings may evict and are excluded from native CPU/full-worker attribution.

diagnostic.scope: Opt-in hooks observe this painter's ordered rectangle/fill/stroke/text calls, dimensions, transform and font notifications. Identical commands do not prove physical-pixel equivalence. Hooks perturb timings; use uninstrumented captures for comparisons. No source strings or command streams are published.

default_off_native_probe.scope: Real EthLib native GUI, unchanged deployed assets and executable; opt-in hooks disabled.

validation.scope: Required installed-tool/scripted-provider public TUI, actual native graph/retained-tab/fading/geometry journeys and a real browser Canvas diagnostic-cap check. Not live-model, cold-install, local-inference, confidentiality or new proof evidence.

remaining: First-exposure geometry/paint and native query/full-input validation still dominate observed waits. Generic layout/collection, navigation annotation ownership and final retirement remain open in the full migration plan.
